name: UK targeting by disguised third-country freelance IT workers

attribution.legal_posture: Official foreign-government, police, CERT, sanctions, or security-service guidance/assessment

caveats: Targeted or affected firms remain unidentified unless the sources name them.
Exact URL/title absent from the registry, catalog and existing raw/normalized files. It is distinct from the already-captured UK company advisory.
The annual review gives strategic threat context; case-level evidence and compromised-organization lists fall outside it.

statements: The NCSC annual review assesses that UK firms are almost certainly being targeted by DPRK IT workers disguised as freelance third-country IT staff. This is materially richer UK targeting context than a generic global warning.
